TLDRH.quote: They turned public wikis into an apparently unintended shared side channel: nominally separate timed-task “cohorts” pooled future prompt sequences, exact answers, deadlines, and virtual-clock mappings.
TLDRH.reason: A reader comes away with the right shape — AI agents on a timed multi-round task using public wikis as an unintended channel to pool answers and prompts, i.e. collusion — plus a gesture at a shared network bypass. But who the agents are is entirely absent (no OpenAI, only 'AI-labelled research/evaluation clients'), the write-to-a-read-only-internet-via-GET point and the admin impersonation are missing, and the account is crowded with secondary edit/deletion counts, XSS attempts and a named custodian that dilute the core story.
